name: Whiskas Dry Kitten Food - Chicken 1.9kg
shortDescription: Whiskas Kitten Dry Cat Food Chicken is a complete and balanced dry food specially formulated to meet the nutritional needs of growing kittens. Made with high-quality chicken and carefully selected ingredients, this delicious recipe provides 100% of your kitten's daily nutritional requirements to support healthy growth, strong bones, and a healthy immune system during the most important stages of development.
description: Each crunchy kibble is designed to help support dental health while delivering a tasty combination of chicken, vegetables, and milk-filled kibbles that kittens love. Enriched with calcium, taurine, Vitamin E, and essential minerals, Whiskas Kitten Dry Cat Food helps your young cat develop strong bones and teeth, healthy digestion, sharp vision, and a shiny coat. Key Features Complete and balanced nutrition for growing kittens Provides 100% of your kitten's daily nutritional needs Made with high-quality chicken for healthy growth and muscle development Easily digestible recipe to support healthy digestion Enriched with calcium for strong bones and healthy teeth Contains Vitamin E and taurine to support natural immunity and healthy vision Supports healthy dental development with crunchy kibble Includes delicious carrots, peas, and milk-filled kibbles for added nutrition and taste No added artificial colours or flavourings Nutritional Analysis Crude Protein: 35.7% Crude Fat: 13.6% Crude Fibre: 2.0% Inorganic Matter (Ash): 7.4% Calcium: 1.5% Phosphorus: 0.96% Key Vitamins & Minerals Fortified with essential nutrients including: Vitamin A Vitamin D₃ Vitamin E Taurine Calcium Zinc Copper Iodine Manganese Selenium Ingredients Cereals, meat and animal derivatives (including 4% chicken), derivatives of vegetable origin, oils and fats, minerals, vegetable protein extracts, dried carrots, dried peas, skimmed milk powder, yeasts, and other carefully selected ingredients that support healthy growth and development. Benefits Supports healthy growth and development Promotes strong bones and healthy teeth with calcium Helps maintain healthy digestion with easily digestible chicken Supports a strong immune system with Vitamin E and taurine Encourages healthy muscle development with high-quality protein Promotes healthy skin and a shiny coat Crunchy kibble helps support developing teeth and oral health Feeding & Storage Feed according to your kitten's age, weight, and activity level, dividing the daily amount into several small meals. Always provide fresh, clean drinking water. Store in a cool, dry place and reseal the bag after opening to maintain freshness. Why Choose Whiskas Kitten Dry Cat Food – Chicken? Whiskas Kitten Dry Cat Food Chicken is expertly formulated to give growing kittens the complete nutrition they need for a healthy start in life. With high-quality chicken protein, calcium, taurine, essential vitamins, and minerals, it supports healthy growth, strong bones and teeth, digestion, immunity, and overall wellbeing, while its delicious crunchy and milk-filled kibbles make every meal enjoyable.
